text:
emily: Quickheads: ran through the Python quickstart sample with a new hire and hit a few onboarding blockers. Posting notes.
raj: thanks, what did you find?
emily: Repo: `docs/quickstarts/python/chatbot/`. Problems: 1) README shows `import redwood` but package uses `redwood_inference` so import fails. 2) Example mixes async and sync: calls `client.generate(...)` in top-level code without `await` or an `asyncio.run`. 3) Dockerfile doesn't forward http_proxy so corporate env builds fail.
kevin: Oof. Import mismatch is a big UX trap. New users copy-paste and get ModuleNotFoundError.
zara: For (2) we should show both a sync helper and an `asyncio.run(main())` pattern. Also add a small note about how to use in REPLs.
emily: Here's the offending snippet from README: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.generate("Hi")
print(resp.text)
```
raj: Yikes. Also the Dockerfile uses `ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/python"]` which fails in slim images. Suggest using `#!/usr/bin/env python3` in scripts and `python3` in ENTRYPOINT.
kevin: I'll open a docs PR: change imports to `redwood_inference` (or better: update setup.cfg to expose `redwood` top-level package) and add typed examples `from redwood_inference import Client, GenerateResponse`.
zara: I'll add the sync wrapper example: `def generate_sync(prompt): return asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(client.generate(prompt))` and also `if __name__ == "__main__": asyncio.run(main())`.
docs-bot: Link-checker: found 2 broken links in `docs/quickstarts/python/chatbot/README.md` at 1856789020.
ci-bot: Suggest adding a tiny smoke test to samples CI: `python -c "import redwood_inference"` and `python -c "import asyncio; asyncio.run(main())"` to catch both import and async regressions.
emily: Can we also add a short note about Alpine vs Debian: alpine needs `python3` and `py3-pip`. Add `ARG http_proxy` and `ENV http_proxy=$http_proxy` to Dockerfile so builds in proxied envs succeed.
raj: Good plan. Label PR with `docs` and `devex`. main-only landing.
emily: I'll link the PR here when it's open. Thanks all!
